components.name: Default button
components.css: .ds-button-default { box-sizing: border-box; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.75rem; padding-inline: 1.25rem; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 0.625rem); background: var(--primary, #1c608e); background-clip: padding-box; color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 600 0.8125rem/1.375rem var(--font-sans, "Vazirmatn Variable", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-default:hover { background-color: var(--primary-hover, #16496e); } .ds-button-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #336998); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-default:disabled { opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-button-default { transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, translate 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-default:active:not(:disabled) { translate: 0 1px; } }

components.name: Highlight button
components.css: .ds-button-highlight { box-sizing: border-box; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.75rem; padding-inline: 1.25rem; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 0.625rem); background: var(--highlight, #124c79); background-clip: padding-box; color: var(--highlight-foreground, #fff); font: 600 0.8125rem/1.375rem var(--font-sans, "Vazirmatn Variable", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-highlight:hover { background-color: var(--highlight-hover, #0c375a); } .ds-button-highlight:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #336998); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-highlight:disabled { opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-button-highlight { transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, translate 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-highlight:active:not(:disabled) { translate: 0 1px; } }

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Secondary action with a defined control edge.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { box-sizing: border-box; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.75rem; padding-inline: 1.25rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--input, #7188a0); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 0.625rem); background: transparent; background-clip: padding-box; color: var(--foreground, #132d49); font: 600 0.8125rem/1.375rem var(--font-sans, "Vazirmatn Variable", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background-color: var(--accent, #e2eff9); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #336998); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-button-outline { transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, translate 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-outline:active:not(:disabled) { translate: 0 1px; } }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Text input with a 1.5px edge and shared keyboard focus ring.
components.html: <input dir="rtl" class="ds-input" type="text" aria-label="نام و نام خانوادگی" placeholder="نام و نام خانوادگی">
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.25rem 1rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--input, #7188a0); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 0.5rem); background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #132d49); font: 0.9375rem/1.625rem var(--font-sans, "Vazirmatn Variable", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #466178); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--muted-foreground, #466178); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #336998); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-input { transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } }

components.name: Site navigation
components.description: Muted links with a primary underline on the current page.
components.html: خدماتویزیت اولیادداشت‌ها
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; column-gap: 0.5rem; border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border, #d1e0ed); background: var(--card, #fff); } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.5rem; align-items: center; padding-inline: 0.375rem; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.375rem var(--font-sans, "Vazirmatn Variable", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--muted-foreground, #466178); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:is(:hover, :focus-visible, [aria-current=page]) { color: var(--foreground, #132d49); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #336998); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current=page]::after { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0.375rem; inset-block-end: 0; height: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #1c608e); content: ""; } @media (width >= 40rem) { .ds-nav { column-gap: 1rem; } } @media (width >= 64rem) { .ds-nav { border-block-start: 0; } .ds-nav-link { height: 4.5rem; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-nav-link { transition: color 150ms; } }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Compact label with the accent wash and brand text.
components.css: .ds-badge { box-sizing: border-box; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.5rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent, #e2eff9); color: var(--brand-text, #1b629b); font: 500 0.75rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans, "Vazirmatn Variable", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Linked card
components.description: An independent surface that gains a deeper shadow on hover or focus.
components.html: معاینه و پیشگیریمعاینهٔ دندان‌ها و لثه‌ها، جرم‌گیری و مرور عادت‌های مراقبت روزانه.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 1.25rem; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 1.125rem); background: var(--card, #fff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border, #d1e0ed), var(--elevation-sm, 0 1px 2px #0000000a, 0 2px 8px -2px #0000000d); color: var(--foreground, #132d49); text-decoration: none; } .ds-card-title { font: 600 1.125rem/1.875rem var(--font-sans, "Vazirmatn Variable", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-card-body { color: var(--muted-foreground, #466178); font: 0.8125rem/1.375rem var(--font-sans, "Vazirmatn Variable", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-card:is(:hover, :focus-visible) { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, #e2eff9) 40%, var(--card, #fff)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border, #d1e0ed), var(--elevation-md, 0 1px 2px #0000000a, 0 12px 28px -12px #00000029); } .ds-card:is(:hover, :focus-visible) .ds-card-title { color: var(--brand-text, #1b629b); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #336998); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-card { transition: background-color 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; } .ds-card-title { transition: color 150ms ease-out; } }

components.name: Homepage question
components.description: A ruled question with a native disclosure and plus or minus icon.
components.html:
اگر ندانم چه خدمتی لازم دارم، چه کنم؟

معاینهٔ اولیه نقطهٔ شروع مناسبی است. بعد از معاینه، دندان‌پزشک توضیح می‌دهد چه گزینه‌هایی برای شما مطرح است و آیا بررسی بیشتری لازم است.
components.css: .ds-question { border-block: 1px solid var(--border, #d1e0ed); color: var(--foreground, #132d49); } .ds-question summary { display: flex; box-sizing: border-box; min-block-size: 3.5rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding-block: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font: 600 1.125rem/1.875rem var(--font-sans, "Vazirmatn Variable", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-question summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-question summary:hover, .ds-question[open] summary, .ds-question summary svg { color: var(--brand-text, #1b629b); } .ds-question summary svg { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-question summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #336998); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-question[open] .ds-question-plus { display: none; } .ds-question p { margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-align-last: start; padding-inline-end: 2rem; padding-block-end: 1.25rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, #466178); font: 1rem/1.75rem var(--font-sans, "Vazirmatn Variable", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif); }

narrative.overview: Avida Dental uses a blue palette and generous Persian line spacing. The full-width homepage hero blends a daylight patient portrait into a blue surface. Ruled lists and pale surfaces make services and visit information easy to scan.
dos: Do use semantic color tokens so surfaces and controls adapt to both themes.
Do show a visible keyboard focus outline on controls and links.
Do identify illustrative images in captions or alternative text.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences for button movement, page transitions, and visit-step animation.
